$comment: Casa Aurora product catalogue, shared by the Shopify, WooCommerce and Nuvemshop demo stores. Shape: scripts/lib/types.ts Product. SKUs (CA-<CAT>-<NNN>-<OPT>) are unique and stable: seed scripts match on them, and orders/orders.json references them. Variant option values are English in every store (the type has no localized option values). Images live in catalog/images/ and are generated by scripts/generate-images.ts. Availability fixtures: mini-succulent-pots is out of stock (0), terra-three-wick-candle is low stock (2).

description.en: Our signature candle, hand-poured in São Paulo into a reusable amber glass jar. Choose warm sandalwood, ripe fig, orange blossom or fresh eucalyptus; each one burns clean and slow for about 45 hours.

Burn time: about 45 hours
Trim the wick to 5 mm before each burn and burn 2–4 hours at a time; never leave it unattended
On the first burn, let the wax melt all the way to the edge (about 2 hours) so it doesn't tunnel

Once empty, wash the jar with warm soapy water and reuse it
